orders.text:
WPMS No. 1169 of 2017 
U.C.Dhyani, J. 
 Mr. Ghanshyam Joshi, Advocate, present for the 
writ petitioners. 
 Mr. R. C. Arya, Standing Counsel, present for 
the State/respondents no. 1 & 2. 
 By means of present writ petition, the petitioner 
prays for the following relief, among others: 
“A writ, order or direction in the nature of 
certiorari quashing the judgment and order dated 
26.10.2016 passed by Additional Commissioner, 
Garhwal Mandal, Camp, Dehradun in Revision 
No. 10 of 2014-15 Jareef vs. State of Uttarakhand 
and others and judgment and order dated 
10.06.2015 passed by Sub Divisional 
Magistrate/Assistant Collector (1st Class), 
Haridwar in Case No. 12 of 2012 Smt. Haseena vs. 
State under Section 33/39 of Land Revenue Act 
allowing the case of respondent no. 3 and 
directing to correct the entries in Revenue record 
of Khatauni 1412Fasli to 1419 fasli of Khata No. 
76 Mauza Mohammadpur Kunhari by mentioning 
Shareef son of Saddiq in place of Jareef son of 
Saddiq..” 
 Issue notices to respondents no. 3 to 6. Steps 
be taken within a week. 
 List after the notices are served upon them. 
 Learned counsel for the State may file 
counter affidavit within four weeks. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.) 
 17.05.2017 
Kaushal
